mechanism: Two-stage perplexity-based compression of long code context for a single request
evidence_scope: LongCodeZip employs a dual-stage strategy: (1) coarse-grained compression, which identifies and ranks function-level chunks using conditional perplexity with respect to the instruction, retaining only the most relevant functions
evidence_role: we propose LongCodeZip, a novel plug-and-play code compression framework designed specifically for code LLMs.
